title: PID Gain Scheduler
text: Lookup table based gain scheduling with PID array, 3 inputs, 4 outputs, {Controller type} sets PID controller type P; {Breakpoints saved in gain array} sets the read breakpoints saved in gain array, {Breakpoints} sets the gain scheduling breakpoints, {Use external signal} sets the breakpoints from input port, {Method of obtaining gains}, {P Gain Parameter Name} sets the proportional gain data, {I Gain Parameter Name} sets the integral gain data, {D Gain Parameter Name} sets the derivative gain data, {N Gain Parameter Name} sets the filter gain data, {Data type} sets the floating point precision, {P gain lookup method} sets the proportional gain lookup method Interpolation-Use End, {I gain lookup method} sets the integral gain lookup method Interpolation-Use End, {D gain lookup method} sets the derivative gain lookup method Interpolation-Use End, {N gain lookup method} sets the derivative filter gain lookup method Interpolation-Use End, {Saturate to max or min when overflows occur} sets the method of overflow action, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data and {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Controller type
params.values: PID controller type P (default) | I | PI | PD | PDN | PID | PIDN

params.name: Breakpoints saved in gain array
params.values: Read breakpoints saved in gain array off (default) | on

params.name: Use external signal
params.values: Specify breakpoints from input port off (default) | on

params.name: Method of obtaining gains
params.values: Method of obtaining gains Data store memory (default) | Goto/from | Input to block

params.name: P Gain Parameter Name
params.values: Proportional gain data name PGain (default) | string

params.name: I Gain Parameter Name
params.values: Integral gain data name IGain (default) | string

params.name: D Gain Parameter Name
params.values: Derivative gain data name DGain (default) | string

params.name: N Gain Parameter Name
params.values: Filter gain data name NGain (default) | string

params.name: P gain lookup method
params.values: Proportional gain lookup method Interpolation-Use End Values (default) | Interpolation-Extrapolation | Use Input Nearest | Use Input Below | Use Input Above

params.name: I gain lookup method

params.name: D gain lookup method

params.name: N gain lookup method
params.values: Derivative filter gain lookup method Interpolation-Use End Values (default) | Interpolation-Extrapolation | Use Input Nearest | Use Input Below | Use Input Above

params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on

params.name: Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools
